the lone calc was fun. At 225 per month it needs to do about 2 days of human work in 30*24=720 hours or deliver 31 cents of value per hour on average. That  would give it almost an hour to do what a human is expected to in 1 minute.

If you can grab a box, walk and stack it in 10 seconds the bot has to do it in 600 seconds (or 200 sec if it only works 8 hours per day along with the humans) that is so much time it either cant do the task or it does it within the time limit.
